<center><h1>SwiChain</h1></center>
<h3>Hey, welcome to my project for week 1 of Half Life by HackClub!</h3> 

So basically my project is a little macropad based on Seeed XIAO nRF52840 and will be running ZMK firmware! It has 7 MX style switches, EC11 encoder and 6 WS2812 LEDs for underglow. It runs out of one 18650 li-ion battery that is charged by the xiao. I think it'll be ok to use without a case, but I might design one when the PCB arrives. Also here are some 3D previews of the PCB and a schematic!
